name: Look up a member by number or last name
goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator. The member lookup screen supports searching either by member number or by last name; search using the given member number, since it is the unambiguous identifier, and open that member's record. Read back the member's full name as shown on the record screen. Note: this system has no member-level status field, only per-share status (each share row has its own OPEN/HOLD status) -- do not read a share's status here and do not report one as if it were the member's overall status; this capability only confirms the member exists and returns their name.

outputs.name: member_name
outputs.description: Full name shown on the member record.

business_outcomes.description: No member record matches the given member number — a legitimate negative result.
Bad operator ID or password -- a legitimate rejection, not a system failure.
